svg.title: The trust boundaries of Paperless Sync
svg.desc: Five numbered arrows cross a trust boundary. 1: the browser of an administrator sends requests to Paperless Sync in Nextcloud. 2: the app calls Paperless-ngx. 3: the app writes the files below the base folder of the target user. 4: whoever may write to the inbox folder puts files there. 5: a workflow of Paperless-ngx, or anyone on the network, calls the webhook of the app. The app keeps the API token and the hash of the secret of the webhook in the credentials manager. The browser, the writers of the inbox, Paperless-ngx and the callers of the webhook are untrusted and have a dashed red border.
